title: Forgetting coefficients preserves bijective section restriction
statement: Let i:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], r a natural number and M a sheaf of Z/rZ-modules on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write U for forgetting to abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. If the canonical module-valued section restriction Γ(X,M)→Γ(Y,i^*M) is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-finite-section-pullback], then the canonical abelian section restriction Γ(X,U(M))→Γ(Y,i^*U(M)) is bijective [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No acyclicity or primality assumption is made.

proof.text: Construct the coefficient-forgetting inverse-image comparison from Mathlib leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves and sheafComposeNatIso. Restriction of scalars to integers is a left adjoint by restrictCoextendScalarsAdj; the integer-module equivalence gives that forgetting coefficients is left adjoint and thus preserves Kan extensions and sheafification. This is the private pullbackForgetIso construction, using the inverse-image definition and the category of abelian sheaves.

Expand the inverse-image unit into its Kan-extension and sheafification units. Apply toSheafify_naturality, sheafComposeIso_hom_fac and leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves_inv_fac to obtain the unit compatibility square. Evaluate it at the terminal object. In globalSectionsUpperStarMap all factors except this evaluated unit are isomorphisms, so the hypothesis makes the module unit an isomorphism. The forgotten module unit is an isomorphism, and the comparison square makes the abelian unit an isomorphism by IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right. Reinsert the terminal/global-sections isomorphisms and use ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso.
